title: Main Facts and Occurrences in the Province of Latina
seoTitle: Main Facts and Occurrences in the Province of Latina
subtitle: A complete overview with the main events recorded in the territory
excerpt: Check the summary of the main incidents recorded in the province of Latina, including investigations, accidents and recent events.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The flow of information about recent happenings in the province of Latina draws great public interest due to a series of police incidents, accidents and notable episodes in the region. The episodes involve ongoing investigations, enforcement operations and facts that resonate within local communities.

Tragedy in Allumiere and Victim Identification

Authorities are investigating the death of two Pontine street vendors at a stall during the village festival. The lifeless bodies of Francesco Di Fazio and Gabriele Tullio were found, with the most likely hypothesis being death caused by carbon monoxide. The prosecutor’s office has opened an investigation and will order an autopsy.

Violence and Assaults in Aprilia

A man was struck on the head by a cobblestone, sustaining serious injuries and being taken to hospital while the carabinieri conduct a thorough investigation. In addition, five shots were fired at the gate of a building on London Street in the Toscanini district, marking the second gun intimidation of August. In another incident in the city, a 55‑year‑old man was beaten and hit with a stone, prompting a search for the perpetrators by the territorial carabinieri department.

Traffic Accidents and Incidents

Basem Mediouni, 36, from Cori, died in a motorcycle accident in Valnerina, while his companion, who was with him, was rescued and operated on after the crash between Terni and Perugia. In Gaeta, a driver ran over a woman on Flacca and fled without providing assistance, but later turned himself in at the carabinieri barracks in the province of Caserta and is being investigated for failure to assist and serious injury. On Sabotino Street, a collision between a car and a scooter left a man injured after the vehicle vaulted into a ditch.

Control and Inspection Operations

The Anti‑Subversion and Sanitary Unit carried out seizures in Ponza, confiscating twelve kilograms of fish products in unsuitable condition. Integrated controls covered commercial establishments, highways and night‑movement zones over the weekend.

Other Notable Facts in the Territory

  • A woman was stabbed by her brother during an argument in Santi Cosma e Damiano, was taken to hospital and the man was arrested for attempted homicide.
  • In Formia, a man accused of persecutory acts received a restraining order with an electronic bracelet for stalking his ex‑partner and threatening to release an intimate video.
  • Alessio Carapellotti died after a long illness, having married Martina Castellucci in the hospital.
  • The opposition questions the management of the Francioni stadium and fans demand public answers from the administration.
  • The cultural review in Nicolosi faces the risk of interruption due to bureaucratic issues and administrative hurdles.
  • The Palio dell'Anello in Cisterna crowned Alessandro Fiorini of Artena as the winner.

With information from LatinaToday.
